26-PERSON ROSTER SEARCH RESULTS

Start with Roster-comparison-and-sheets.pdf.

Five-Day Flow FDF-26-C1: primary option if avoiding mixed early/late weeks is the priority.
Second Gear Refined SGR-26-C2: alternative with 18 one-turn weeks and lower peak hours.

Both are review candidates. Independently reconstructed checks pass; the original roster app checker was not supplied and has not been run. Actual SP cover times must still satisfy rest and fatigue limits. No global optimum is claimed.

The two import files are tab-separated, Sunday to Saturday, with 26 numbered lines. RD means rest day. SP means a four-duty cover week counted as 35 contracted hours.

Checks contains baseline imports, full metrics, a standard-library Python verifier and the conditional weekend bound. From this folder run:
python3 Checks/verify.py Checks/Second-Sight-SS-26-F1-import.txt Five-Day-Flow-FDF-26-C1-import.txt
python3 Checks/verify.py Checks/Second-Gear-SG-26-H1-import.txt Second-Gear-Refined-SGR-26-C2-import.txt
